DataDetectJobSession.name: DataDetectJobSession
DataDetectJobSession.description: Represents a run of a DataDetect scan policy that's triggered manually.

DataDetectPolicyId.description: ID of the scan policy associated with this job session.This field is a relationship field.

DataDetectPolicySnapshotId.description: ID of the snapshot of the scan policy associated with this job session.This field is a relationship field.

SessionEndTime.description: Time and date when the data scan completes.

Name.description: Auto-generated name of the job session.

NamedEntityCount.description: Aggregate count of PII found during the data scan.

PolicyJobStatus.description: Status of the data scan. Valid values are: Stopped Completed Failed PartialSuccess Running Scheduled TimedOut The default value is Scheduled.

RunByUser.description: User who started the job session or data scan.

SessionStartTime.description: Time and date when the data scan begins.

EndTime.description: Time and date when the data scan completes.

HasClassicEncryptedField.description: Indicates that if the user is permitted to view classic encrypted fields, they can view these fields in the scan results. The default value is false.
